source_claim: The official Macross site page for the Macross Delta theatrical film Zettai Live!!!!!! lists the characters 闇フレイア (Yami Freyja), 闇レイナ (Yami Reina), and 闇マキナ (Yami Makina), provides individual profiles for each, and identifies them as virtualoids created by the Siren Delta System and members of Yami_Q_ray.
notes: All three current campaign identities appear explicitly and individually on the official film page.
